nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure function performing overflow-checked addition via require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure function performing underflow-checked subtraction via require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure function performing overflow-checked multiplication.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure function performing division with require(b > 0).
Public address state variable holding the current contract owner; set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Public address state variable holding the pending owner during two-step ownership transfer.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner; protected by require(msg.sender == owner).
Finalizes ownership handover; requires msg.sender == newOwner, then writes owner and clears newOwner.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender at deployment.
Public string state variable for the token symbol, set to "CHIBA" in the constructor.
Public string state variable for the token name, set to "ChefShiba" in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable for token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint state variable holding the total token supply, minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
Internal mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances; written by transfer and transferFrom and read by balanceOf and totalSupply.
Internal nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances; written by approve/approveAndCall and decremented by transferFrom.
ChefShiba constructor: sets symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-allocates the entire supply to 0xdefE85CCDB092c8F5b53563A6B4e0E1C453C8AFe.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)], using raw unchecked subtraction instead of SafeMath.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner] for an arbitrary address supplied by the caller.
ERC20 transfer: debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and credits balances[to] via safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
ERC20 approve: writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without any double-spend protection and emits Approval.
ERC20 transferFrom: debits balances[from], decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using SafeMath helpers.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance then performs an external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) on an attacker-selectable contract.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting all plain Ether transfers.
onlyOwner function that invokes ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary caller-supplied token contract.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization (onlyOwner, acceptOwnership) and as the key into balances/allowed mappings.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary user-supplied address; target is not validated, making it a malicious/token-callback sink.
External call into an arbitrary spender contract (receiveApproval) executed after the allowance write but with no reentrancy guard.
Raw arithmetic expression _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] executed without SafeMath, an unchecked subtraction.
address to parameter of transfer, the recipient credited in balances.
uint tokens parameter of transfer, the amount routed through safeSub/safeAdd.
address spender parameter of approve, the allowance grantee.
uint tokens parameter of approve, the allowance amount written to allowed.
address from parameter of transferFrom, the debited account and allowance owner.
address to parameter of transferFrom, the credited recipient.
uint tokens parameter of transferFrom, the amount debited and credited.
address spender parameter of approveAndCall, used both as allowance key and as the external call target.
uint tokens parameter of approveAndCall, the allowance amount and value forwarded to receiveApproval.
bytes data parameter of approveAndCall, forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
address tokenAddress parameter of transferAnyERC20Token, the arbitrary contract targeted by the external call.
uint tokens parameter of transferAnyERC20Token, the amount forwarded to the external token transfer.
address _newOwner parameter of transferOwnership, stored into the newOwner state variable.
First uint operand a of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Second uint operand b of SafeMath.safeAdd.
First uint operand a (minuend) of SafeMath.safeSub.
Second uint operand b (subtrahend) of SafeMath.safeSub.
First uint operand a of SafeMath.safeMul.
Second uint operand b of SafeMath.safeMul.
First uint operand a (dividend) of SafeMath.safeDiv.
Second uint operand b (divisor) of SafeMath.safeDiv.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the balances mapping key when transfer debits the caller's balance.
The tokens parameter is the value fed into safeSub/safeAdd during balance updates in transfer.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeSub to debit balances[msg.sender].
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeAdd to credit balances[to].
msg.sender is the owner index of allowed in approve.
The spender parameter becomes the second key of the allowed mapping in approve.
The tokens parameter is written verbatim into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
msg.sender is the spender key used to decrement allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
The from parameter selects the balances and allowed entries read and written by transferFrom.
The to parameter selects the balances entry credited by transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the amount passed to safeSub and safeAdd inside transferFrom.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeSub twice to debit balance and allowance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
msg.sender is the owner index of allowed in approveAndCall and is forwarded into the external call.
The spender parameter is both the allowance key and the address of the external contract called by approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter sets the allowance and is forwarded to receiveApproval.
The data parameter is forwarded unchanged into the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall performs an external contract call (receiveApproval) after writing state, with no reentrancy guard, allowing the callee to re-enter token functions.
The attacker-controlled spender parameter determines which contract implements receiveApproval and thus the callee of the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to the token contract identified by tokenAddress.
tokenAddress controls the target of the external ERC20Interface call and is not validated against a whitelist.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to gate transferAnyERC20Token.
The owner state variable is read in the onlyOwner check and used as the recipient of the swept tokens.
The tokens parameter is forwarded as the amount argument of the external token transfer.
The _newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable by transferOwnership.
transferOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
owner is read inside the onlyOwner modifier guarding transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner, an authorization check on caller identity.
newOwner is read during the acceptOwnership authorization check and then cleared.
acceptOwnership writes the privileged owner state variable, transferring full contract control.
The Owned constructor assigns owner from msg.sender at deployment.
The Owned constructor initializes the owner state variable.
The ChefShiba constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed total supply constant.
The ChefShiba constructor pre-allocates the entire supply into balances at the deployer address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply computes _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with raw, unchecked Solidity subtraction rather than SafeMath.safeSub.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping entry for the caller-supplied tokenOwner.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping for the supplied owner and spender.
transfer writes the balances mapping for both the sender and the recipient.
transferFrom writes the balances mapping for both the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for the spender.
approve writes the allowed mapping with the new allowance amount.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before making the external call.
